title: Safely managed sanitation, LDCs, LLDCs and SIDS compared with the World
headline: Safely managed sanitation for all by 2030 needs a rise of 9.7 to 12.2 points a year
subtitle: Proportion of population using an improved sanitation facility that is not shared with other households, from which excreta are safely disposed of in situ or removed and treated off-site
years: In LDCs it has risen 0.5 points a year, from 14.3% in 2000 to 27.0% in 2024.
data_line: Data: WHO/UNICEF JMP via UN SDG Global Database, series SH_SAN_SAFE, extracted 1 Nov 2026
alt: Safely managed sanitation for all by 2030 needs a rise of 9.7 to 12.2 points a year. In LDCs it has risen 0.5 points a year, from 14.3% in 2000 to 27.0% in 2024. LDCs: 0.5 a year observed, 12.2 needed; LLDCs: 0.4 a year observed, 11.2 needed; SIDS: 0.1 a year observed, 9.7 needed; World: 1.1 a year observed, 6.9 needed
method: Method: linear pace on published aggregates, from 2000 for LDCs.
question: Which LDCs have moved safely managed sanitation fastest, and how?
